newsitem.title: USA: St Jude to reduce Ventritex price-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: St Jude to reduce Ventritex price-WSJ.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc is expected to announce an agreement to acquire Ventritex Inc for more than $350 million instead of the original $505 million, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
The purchase of the heart-defibrillator maker came under scrutiny after three patients implanted with its heartbeat-regulating device died.

St. Jude is understood to have decided Ventritex's value had declined, the paper said, citing people familiar with the talks. An announcement about a revised deal could come as early as today, the paper said.
On February 6, St. Jude's chief financial officer told Reuters the acquisition would likely proceed. He declined comment about Wall Street speculation over a lower price.
